Cresselia

Psychic

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Legendary Pokémon

Cresselia is a Psychic-type Lunar Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 85.6 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (120), with a base stat total of 580.
